recipe.builder_distribution: Ubuntu24.04 amd64 at the same signed snapshot; require native binary/source receipt and record ELF dependencies. Do not use a Mac artifact or claim a cross-linker is present.
recipe.root_partition: /dev/sda1 must be verified as the actual Ubuntu root filesystem by libguestfs inspection before resize. A different/unexpected layout fails closed instead of selecting another disk.
recipe.desktop: Real Xorg modesetting on the QEMU virtio-vga device; XFCE session, file manager, terminal and text editor. No Xvfb/dummy display.
recipe.per_assignment_config_required: Native owner must inject its actual enrolled guest_id into the writable overlay, JSON with only guest_id/display/xauthority, mode0600 owned1500:1500, before starting QEMU. Existing operational injection caller is still missing; recipe does not fabricate it.
recipe.raw_derivation: Verify signed fixed upstream checksum; create a new private working copy; expand to8GiB using virt-resize after confirming the actual root partition; configure ONLY that stopped copy; qemu-img convert -f qcow2 -O raw into a new golden-base.raw; sync; record actual raw SHA256, size, package ledger, binary/dependency hashes and command/tool versions. Never modify the downloaded original or an active guest.
recipe.raw_checksum_reason: Cannot truthfully hash an image that has not been approved, downloaded or built. Approval requested is for this exact input and recipe; derived base identity is mandatory before enrollment/activation.
linux_build_commands: lddtree -l <verified-ctox> (record dependencies and copy only verified libraries into matching guest paths)
recipe.build_appliance_network: Only outgoing signed Ubuntu snapshot package acquisition during an approved bounded image build. Does not enable networking in the worker VM. No host shares or privileged host mount into a running worker.

runtime.host_transport: existing owned QMP/virtio Unix sockets; existing native WebRTC guarded frame source

host_constraints.yoda: 135.125.223.119: DevOps verified KVM device O_RDWR after approved existing-group grant; root3.94GiB/no alternate durable data mount, tools absent. Not suitable until DevOps-approved storage yields adequate headroom.
host_constraints.gpu3: 100.71.114.101: root39.66GiB/nvme356.55GiB; user KVM access and QEMU tools absent, sudo requires authenticated Admin. No ACL/privilege bypass.
host_constraints.admission: Main all12 Mac repair remains P0. One admitted image build, at most2 workers/vCPUs, bounded45minutes, at least60GiB staging free before source-build/image preparation, keeping at least20GiB free on system and staging throughout. On Mac all build/cache/temp stays on /Volumes/tmp under mandatory shared admission; remote build only under explicit host capacity/ownership clearance.
host_constraints.durability: Approved final raw image and receipt require durable approved storage and an independent verified copy before cleanup. /Volumes/tmp is only disposable staging, never sole golden image custody. Do not delete shared Docker images or unrelated task data.

required_acceptance: Actual Linux native artifact compilation and relevant guest regressions
Boot the actual assigned KVM child, Xorg/XFCE and native endpoint; fresh same-session capture proof
Authorized capture through actual native guarded P2P queue and rendering, typed input observed in a real application
Revoke/controller change/expiry/child or endpoint death prevents later send and input; no automatic replay
Consistent portable checkpoint and real two-host continuation with old-owner fencing and independent durable copies
approval_scope: Select and permit acquisition/build of this fixed Ubuntu input and source-bound recipe after host/storage clearance. Does not authorize shared-image deletion, credentials/admin bypass, runtime activation, claim native acceptance or substitute force-stop for a consistent checkpoint.
